CharacterDescriptions: Zack Farron is an impulsive hunter in training and machine enthusiast from Landfall Village. His Blade, Victorino, has the unique perk of being able to turn into any tool or weapon.
Lea Joha is one of the many War Orphans living in Landfall Village's orphanage. She is a kind and caring hunter in training who is always willing to help others.
Elwyn Ashrift is a hunter in training from Landfall Village. While being often pushed around by Zack, he never leaves his side.
Sorak Garland is a gruff, experienced Hunter with a deep sense of duty. Once a reckless fighter, he now trains and protects the next generation alongside Lyv.
Lyv Bright is the compassionate head of the Landfall Village Orphanage. Thoughtful and protective, she watches over the others with a motherly eye.
Sieg Meyer is a young archeologist form Occidens City. He often disregards his own safety when it comes to Old World relics.
Mir is a Master Hunter on a quest to destroy Caelum. He never summons his Blade, except in dire situations.
Ruben Donnel is a hunter in training from Landfall Village who trains relentlessly to overcome his fear and protect his friends.
Gusto Havel is a soldier from Occidens City and the aid of Kira Albarn, who he has been watching over since her childhood.
Kira Albarn is the strategic mind of Occidens and the adoptive daughter of Darius Albarn, leader of Occidens. She is a skilled fighter and tactician, often leading her team into battle.
Gwenie Anbony is a pirate who decided to defect to join Kira's team. Her lawless nature often puts her in murky situations.
Description for Kay Anbony
Bob Archad is a general of the Archadian army. Despite being only able to wield the most basic blade, his mastery makes him a formidable fighter.
Gale Magnus is a composed hunter famed in Archadian for his strength which earned him the title of "Hero's heir".
Aurora Dawn is an Archadian hunter and Gale Magnus' companion. While she is reserved and quiet, her healing abilities are unmatched.
Erica Kraft is a battle crazed hunter from Landfall Village. She has been drafted to be part of the Occidens army. She joined Zack's army to have fun and slay pluvials.
